summary: Follow a file from your device to the cloud, then see how uploads resume, versions stay recoverable and devices catch up.
scope: An original educational walkthrough of a Drive-like design. The public Drive API documents upload, revisions, sharing and changes. The internal service topology and technologies shown here are illustrative.
author: Thoth

sources.title: Google Drive API · Sharing and permissions

componentNotes.user: Choose a file on any device.
componentNotes.desktop: Watch a local folder for changes.
componentNotes.web: List files and request uploads or downloads.
componentNotes.mobile: Use the same files over a mobile connection.
componentNotes.api: Route file, upload and share requests. Rate limits protect the system under load.
componentNotes.auth: Verify identity and device credentials before handling a request.
componentNotes.upload: Remember which bytes arrived so interrupted uploads can resume.
componentNotes.chunks: Split data into chunks, hash with SHA-256 and reuse matches within a security boundary. A 4 MB chunk is an example.
componentNotes.storage: Store durable, encrypted and replicated chunks. Cloud Storage is an illustrative provider.
componentNotes.metadata: Store file names, folders, owner, size, MIME type and references to committed chunks.
componentNotes.versions: Keep a list of chunk references for each saved version so a prior version can be restored.
componentNotes.permissions: Apply file and folder access rules for owners, editors, commenters and viewers.
componentNotes.jobs: Schedules independent work after file metadata changes.
componentNotes.search: Index file names and supported text. Filter results by access.
componentNotes.previews: Render thumbnails and previews in the background.
componentNotes.scan: Detect suspicious files and apply data loss prevention rules.
componentNotes.quota: Track usage and enforce storage limits before committing data.
componentNotes.trash: Keep recoverable files for a retention window and remove chunks when no retained version uses them.
componentNotes.sync: Keep a change journal. Pull updates since a cursor and preserve conflict copies when needed.
componentNotes.queue: Queue file creation, update and sharing events for asynchronous delivery.
componentNotes.notify: Signal changes over WebSockets or long polling. Clients use their cursor to retrieve updates.
componentNotes.other-desktop: Update the local folder after a change.
componentNotes.other-web: Refresh the file view after pulling changes.
componentNotes.server: Check access and locate the requested file.
componentNotes.result: Show a preview or return the file.
